common_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished high fidelity desktop UI screenshot for SICP 本地数据中台, a Chinese data administration console, as part of a consistent 28-screen design review. Raster image, 1920x1200 landscape, straight-on full-screen interface, no monitor/device frame, no perspective, no decorative photography. Logical viewport 1440x900; crisp Chinese typography, Chinese labels legible and carefully spelled, realistic moderate density, professional enterprise tool. Physical user: data administrator reviewing tables at an office desktop in daylight. White content, neutral light-gray #F6F6F6 workspace, dark charcoal text, secondary text #686158, deep ochre primary #795B26, pale ochre selected rows only, green/red/amber semantic icons accompanied by text. Accent <10% area. No blue default theme, gradients, huge metric cards, decorative charts, oversized headings, glass, chunky shadows, excessive rounding. 6px controls, 8px panel corners, hairline dividers, mostly flat layout with whitespace, 14px logical body text, 24px heading. Consistent shell: 56px topbar, 216px left sidebar, main 24px padding; product brand small dark-ochre square S mark and “SICP” plus “本地数据中台”. Sidebar ordered labels “运行总览”, “接口中心”, “业务查询”, “更新事件”, “数据源”, “日志中心”, “通知中心”, “系统设置”; line icons, active item pale ochre fill. Sidebar bottom “测试环境” and version “设计稿 V1”. Topbar breadcrumb left; right small “设计预览 · 示例数据”, administrator avatar and “管理员”. Not a marketing website. Meaningful exact text over dense fake paragraphs. IDs and JSON monospace. Tables 44px logical rows, aligned numbers, visible sensible headers. Every datum is synthetic; S000001, T000001, DEPT001, CLASS001, COURSE001, 教学班 TEACHING001, dates 2026-10-10. Primary action one per section. Maintain shell across all desktop pages. Important: represent proposed UI, not actual deployed status.
STRICT PRODUCT ACCURACY: Do not invent ANY actions or endpoint fields. There is NO 新建接口, export, create user, edit data, course enrollment, delete record action. Navigation only specified labels. Unimplemented is NEUTRAL GRAY “未实现”, not red error. Unknown administrative-class path MUST show “路径待定”, no invented URL. Academic year default MUST be “未设置（最近学期）”, never all by default. page_size default100 maximum1000, NOT500. JSON success is code STRING "ok", message "OK", request_id string, data object; never code0 or success. If sample data items are not fully specified use items:[] and total:0 instead of inventing fields. Source confirmed progress MUST be timestamp, never percentage. Use only specified source names. No gradients on buttons; flat #795B26. No marketing slogans.
